restaurants.name: Pilar
restaurants.address: 4487-12 Hokujo, Hakuba-mura, Kitaazumi-gun, Nagano 399-9301 (Usagidaira Terrace, top of Adam Gondola)
restaurants.notes: Lunch-only fine dining at the top of the Happo-One gondola with panoramic views of the Hakuba Sanzan. Booking essential in peak season.

restaurants.name: Mimi's
restaurants.notes: Husband-and-wife run Echoland favourite. Housemade pasta, Shinshu salmon and game; bookings strongly recommended.

restaurants.name: Hie
restaurants.notes: Echoland izakaya with charcoal grill, sashimi and a strong sake list. Cozy and small — book ahead.

restaurants.name: Marutama Ramen
restaurants.notes: Echoland ramen specialist with rich tonkotsu and shoyu broths. Walk-in only; expect a queue at peak après-ski hours.

restaurants.name: Sushi Sakai
restaurants.address: 4998 Hokujo, Hakuba-mura, Kitaazumi-gun, Nagano 399-9301 (Hakuba Hospitality Group)
restaurants.notes: Omakase counter sushi in Wadano-no-mori serving Japan Sea seafood. Run by Hakuba Hospitality Group; reservations essential.

restaurants.name: Issei
restaurants.notes: Elegant restaurant in Happo specialising in tonkatsu and hand-cut soba. Quiet local favourite away from the après-ski crowd.
